item.title: Man Arrested at Statesboro Walmart After Threatening Shoppers with Stolen BB Gun

item.title: Genomics offers a faster path to restoring the American chestnut
item.description: For more than a century, the American chestnut, once a dominant tree across eastern North American forests, has been devastated by an invasive fungal disease that killed billions of trees in the early 1900s. A new study published in Science shows that modern genomic tools can dramatically accelerate restoration while preserving the species’ ecological identity. The post Genomics offers a faster path to restoring the American chestnut appeared first on AllOnGeorgia.
